top_signals.summary: China is home to 49% of the world’s “clean industrial plants” thanks to massive investments in energy transition projects, solidifying its position as the biggest investor in wind, solar, batteries, and other alternative energy sources. According to a report by decarbonization outlet the Mission Possible Partnership, China accounted for $45 billion in energy transition investments this year.
